architecture.identity: Unique owner/connection/namespace/generation source plus opaque provider IDs; no name/position inference. Optional approved existing EXTERNAL Agent reference; no registry creation.
architecture.authentication: Existing fixed-owner operator credential approves five-minute opaque per-process grants with role/source/incarnation/domain. Constant-time digest verification; expiry/rotation/disable/capability revalidation; frozen non-sensitive metadata view. No provider-specific signature or production identity claim.
architecture.durability: Receipt PENDING+acceptance audit commits; application then atomically commits external projection/inbox outcome/audit. Unknown mappings/order/correlation defer.
architecture.ordering: Explicit approved immutable source ordering domain; 40-digit sequence strings compared with BigInt; timestamps never determine total order. Terminal state and last known evidence preserved. Unknown source statuses are not cast into native enums.
architecture.recovery: Operator-only exact replay/history cursor pages default 10/max20, stable UUID order. No automatic polling, timers, consumers or dispatch. Reauthorize after restart; durable state remains in PostgreSQL.
architecture.audit: Existing immutable command_audit and structured ApiLogger reused. Compatible duplicate receipt/final processing does not duplicate durable side effects. No raw credentials/provider payload logs.

migration.strategy: Additive four tables, same-owner/referential/unique constraints, history/recovery indexes, immutable identity/history and projection-evidence/type guards. Existing native table definitions/indexes unchanged.
migration.fresh: All 18 public tables verified; new tables empty without seeds; existing migration reapplication/drift checks pass.
migration.upgrade: Separate regex-verified disposable database on the test-owned PG container; apply pre-0007 journal prefix, persist real legacy owner/route/Agent/Task, then apply current migrator and verify legacy Task data/identities unchanged. Temporary DB and folder cleaned with exact-path/name guards.
migration.rollback: Disable source writes/replay and preserve mapping/inbox/audit history first; no destructive reset or dedupe deletion. No production database was targeted.

security.nativeOwnership: No RuntimeCoordinator or lifecycle dependency in ingestion service; no canonical Task/Execution or Agent writes. Tests verify unchanged counts, disabled Agent state and native/external collaboration/delegation status.
security.correlation: EXTERNAL owned session, active membership and exact delegation target required; source-owned events cannot correlate native collaboration or fabricate parent/child Tasks.
security.input: T06 closed plain-record/getter/prototype/length/time/provenance validators plus 12KB encoded event limit and 16KiB DB bound. Known configured/operator credentials rejected; no arbitrary metadata/payload shape.
security.dedupe: Source/event uniqueness, canonical hash excluding receivedAt, incompatible ID reuse rejected, durable owner advisory lock across instances.
security.tenancy: Owner isolation enforced and tested with independent owners; no tenant abstraction exists, so cross-tenant N/A.
security.ingress: No HTTP controller/webhook route; real application POST tests return 404 for generic event/mapping paths.

limitations: Trusted local fixed-owner internal source approval only; no production tenants or public ingress/signature implementation.
No real external adapter is registered. T08 must verify source authentication, capabilities, ID/incarnation/ordering and provider-specific status mapping.
No approved order/domain or unknown/conflicting evidence remains durably deferred; authoritative provider snapshot reconciliation is a T08 prerequisite, not fabricated polling.
No worker/broker/scheduled recovery exists. Tests use controlled durable cuts, fresh Nest contexts, SQL failure injection and explicit replay, not OS hard-kill or worker restart claims.
No native Execution conversion, external Task dispatch/cancellation, Agent creation/NPC binding, activity API, projection to frontend or city change.
Mapping/inbox history has no destructive retention cleanup; dedupe/provenance rows must be retained.
Hosted CI, live provider compatibility, paid APIs and Mermaid renderer execution are not claimed.
